title: Pull from remote
objective: Pull latest changes from the configured remote into the current branch.
instructions: Inspect current branch, remotes, and git status before pulling.
Pull from the configured upstream remote/branch for the current branch; if no upstream is configured, use origin/main only if current branch is main.
Preserve local commits and do not rewrite history.
Do not stage or commit unrelated files.
If pull is blocked by local changes or conflicts, stop and report the blocker without destructive cleanup.
constraints: No force pull, no reset, no rebase unless already configured as the normal pull strategy by git.
expected_outputs: Post-pull status summary and any conflicts/blockers.
definition_of_done: Remote changes are pulled, or a clear non-destructive blocker is reported.
